decks.notes: This Jeskai Control deck focuses on disruption and removal to control the opponent's board while establishing its own threats. Cards like Strangle, Make Disappear, and Wedding Announcement help to deal with opposing creatures, while The Wandering Emperor and Zurgo and Ojutai provide a strong win condition. The deck also utilizes a mix of lands to support its three-color mana base. The inclusion of powerful control spells and creatures, along with a solid mana base, allows this deck to outlast and outmaneuver opponents in a 1 vs 1 Standard format.

This deck focuses on quickly building a strong board presence of low-cost creatures with powerful abilities. By efficiently playing creatures like Yotian Frontliner, Valiant Veteran, and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a steady stream of attacks. Thalia, Guardian of Thraben disrupts the opponent's spells, while Ossification and Invasion of Gobakhan provide additional utility and removal options. Mishra's Foundry and Eiganjo, Seat of the Empire help to ensure consistent mana production and protection for key creatures.

This deck focuses on controlling the board and outlasting opponents by utilizing cards like Topiary Stomper, Archangel of Wrath, and Atraxa, Grand Unifier. It also includes artifacts like The Celestus and Tablet of Compleation to provide additional benefits. The deck uses cards like Realmbreaker, the Invasion Tree and Farewell to disrupt opponent's strategies. Additionally, Herd Migration, Sunfall, and Invasion of Zendikar allow for efficient mana production. Cards like Leyline Binding and Ossification help control the opponent's creatures, while the various lands and headquarters provide the necessary mana to support the strategy.

This deck focuses on using powerful creatures and spells to control the board and overwhelm opponents. By combining creatures like Archangel of Wrath, Atraxa, Grand Unifier, and Etali, Primal Conqueror with spells like Leyline Binding and Invasion of Zendikar, the deck aims to establish dominance and control the game. The inclusion of Topiary Stomper and Ossification provides additional disruption and removal options. The land base and support cards like Herd Migration and Sunfall ensures a balanced and consistent gameplay experience. The deck's strategy revolves around outlasting and outplaying opponents through superior control and power.

The deck focuses on using powerful control spells and creatures to dominate the battlefield, while also utilizing strong mana producing lands to ramp up quickly. The key strategy is to establish board control with cards like Topiary Stomper and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, and then use cards like Leyline Binding and Ossification to disrupt the opponent's plans. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Archangel of Wrath and The Celestus to close out the game. Overall, the deck aims to control the game tempo and outvalue the opponent with its strong board presence.

This Bant Aggro deck focuses on aggressive play through creature pump spells and efficient creatures. The key strategy is to quickly build a board presence with cheap creatures like Cityscape Leveler and Titan of Industry, then use pump spells like Ossification and Brokers Charm to overwhelm the opponent. Cards like Invasion of Ikoria and Vesuvan Drifter provide additional value and disruption. The deck also includes a mix of control with cards like Negate and Farewell to handle opposing threats. Overall, the deck aims to pressure the opponent early and maintain a strong board presence.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize aggressive tactics and efficient removal spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent with low-cost, powerful creatures and disruptive spells. The deck focuses on leveraging the power of mono black cards to control the board and deal direct damage, using cards like Liliana of the Veil and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to maintain pressure. The inclusion of support cards like Sword of Once and Future and Corrupt Court Official further boosts the aggressive playstyle of the deck, aiming to close out the game swiftly with a combination of creatures and spells.

The main idea of this aggro-red deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast and efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Bloodthirsty Adversary. By using cheap removal spells like Lightning Strike and Play with Fire, along with direct damage from cards like Kumano, the deck aims to burn down the opponent's life total quickly. With a focus on aggression and a good mix of creatures and burn spells, this deck aims to finish the game swiftly before the opponent can stabilize.

This deck focuses on quickly establishing a strong board presence with low-cost creatures and then using combat tricks and removal spells to maintain control of the battlefield. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive attacks while protecting key creatures and disrupting the opponent's game plan. Key features include token generation, evasion abilities, and cards that provide additional value when attacking. It also includes a mix of creatures with different abilities to ensure flexibility in different situations. Additionally, the deck benefits from lands that allow for a smooth mana curve and access to various colors of mana.

This deck focuses on a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells to maintain control over the game. By utilizing the power of creatures like Dennick, Pious Apprentice and Raffine, Scheming Seer, the deck can quickly establish a threatening board presence. Additionally, cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Go for the Throat help to disrupt opponents' strategies and clear the way for your creatures to deal damage. The mana base of the deck also allows for consistent casting of spells and creatures, ensuring a smooth and efficient gameplay experience.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and removal spells, using Mono Black Aggro strategy. By combining efficient creatures like Tainted Adversary and Graveyard Trespasser with powerful removal spells like Go for the Throat and Cut Down, the deck aims to maintain pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan. Additionally, cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Gix, Yawgmoth Praetor provide added value and resilience to the deck. Overall, the deck focuses on a fast and aggressive playstyle to secure victory.

The primary focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and efficient spells that enhance their power. By utilizing cards like Cosmic Hunger, Infectious Bite, and March of Burgeoning Life, the deck can quickly build a threatening board presence. Additionally, cards like Tamiyo's Safekeeping and Unnatural Restoration provide protection and resilience against removal spells, allowing the deck to maintain pressure on the opponent. Overall, the deck aims to ramp up quickly and maintain a steady stream of threats to secure victory.

The main focus of this deck is to establish control over the game using white cards with powerful effects. By utilizing cards like Destroy Evil, Ossification, and Lay Down Arms, the player can disrupt their opponent's strategies and maintain board control. Archangel Elspeth and Elspeth Resplendent provide strong creatures for offense and defense, while cards like Investigator's Journal and The Restoration of Eiganjo offer card advantage and protection. The deck also includes versatile creatures like Serra Paragon and Ambitious Farmhand to adapt to different situations. Overall, this deck aims to outlast the opponent and secure victory through strategic plays.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly overwhelm your opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. By playing cheap, efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Phoenix Chick, combined with powerful burn spells like Lightning Strike and Play with Fire, you aim to deal damage quickly and efficiently. Cards like Bloodthirsty Adversary and Kumano Faces Kakkazan provide additional ways to push damage through. Utilizing cards like Feldon, Ronom Excavator and Mishra's Foundry can help ensure you have the resources necessary to maintain pressure on your opponent.

The deck focuses on building a strong board presence quickly with aggressive creatures and support cards like Generous Visitor and Spirited Companion. It also includes some control elements with cards like Ossification and Seal from Existence to deal with threats. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and efficient aggro strategy, while also having some resilience and staying power with cards like The Restoration of Eiganjo and Hallowed Haunting. It leverages the Selesnya color combination to create a well-rounded and versatile deck for Standard 1 vs 1 play.

This deck focuses on quickly building a board presence of low-cost, efficient creatures to overwhelm the opponent early in the game. Utilizing cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar, the deck applies steady pressure while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Anointed Peacekeeper. Ossification helps to protect key creatures, while cards like Invasion of Gobakhan provide a powerful finisher. With a low mana curve and consistent aggression, this deck aims to win the game swiftly through efficient creature combat and strategic disruption.
